subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this permanent native completion-routing contract across the tool schema, global and per-agent configuration, and persisted subagent state?
rationale: The patch is correct and well-proven, but current main does not establish this public direction and no owner has confirmed that all three surfaces are the desired long-term product contract.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close now and reopen this PR when an agents owner explicitly sponsors the full contract or requests a narrowed version.

options.title: Sponsor full contract
options.body: Retain or reopen the PR and approve the per-spawn argument, both configuration levels, and restart-durable routing semantics.

options.title: Request per-spawn only
options.body: Invite a narrower revision that keeps explicit caller-selected routing but removes the global and per-agent defaults.
